title: Queen's Chamber shaft points at Orion

tellings.quote: chamber don't point at Orion, but one of the shafts of the Queen Chamber does.

related.note: Both say which star targets the Great Pyramid's chamber shafts point at. This telling puts Sirius on the Queen's Chamber, where the story says a Queen's Chamber shaft points at Orion.

plain: One of the narrow shafts running out of the Queen's Chamber, a room inside the Great Pyramid at Giza, is said to point at Orion, the star pattern of the hunter, while the shafts of another chamber do not. The writer Graham Hancock says this, without naming a source, as part of his case that the pyramid was lined up with the stars on purpose.
